-- Compatibility/safety helpers. The original script assumed every map object
-- existed immediately, which can abort the entire script before the UI loads.
local function getChildrenOf(name)
    local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not obj then return {} end
    return obj:GetChildren()
end

local function findPath(root, ...)
    local current = root
    for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
        if not current then return nil end
        current = current:FindFirstChild(select(i, ...))
    end
    return current
end

local function safeCanCollide(part, value)
    if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
        part.CanCollide = value
    end
end

            if Highlight then
                Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
            end

            t2.value32 = nil
        end

        return
    end

    if p12 == true then
        t2.value34 = true
        t2.value29.Visible = true
        t2.value30.Visible = true

        for _, player in ipairs(t2.value4:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= t2.value5 then
                if player.Character and not player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight") then
                    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

                    Highlight.Adornee = player.Character
                    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
                    Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
                    Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                    Highlight.Parent = player.Character
                end

                t2.value37[player] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
                    character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

                    Highlight.Adornee = character
                    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
                    Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
                    Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                    Highlight.Parent = character
                end)
            end
        end

        t2.value36 = t2.value4.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
            if player == t2.value5 then
                return
            end

            t2.value37[player] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
                character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

                Highlight.Adornee = character
                Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
                Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
                Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                Highlight.Parent = character
            end)
        end)
        t2.value35 = t2.value13.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not t2.value34 then
                return
            end
            local v156 = t2.value31:ScreenPointToRay(v60, v61)
            local Origin = v156.Origin
            local Direction = v156.Direction
            local v159
            local huge = math.huge
            for v163, v164 in ipairs(t2.value4:GetPlayers()) do

                if v164 ~= t2.value5 and v164.Character then
                    local HumanoidRootPart = v164.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if HumanoidRootPart and (HumanoidRootPart.Position - t2.value31.CFrame.Position):Dot(t2.value31.CFrame.LookVector) > 0 then
                        local Magnitude = (Origin + Direction * (HumanoidRootPart.Position - Origin):Dot(Direction) - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

                        if Magnitude < huge then
                            huge = Magnitude
                            v159 = HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if t2.value32 and v159 ~= t2.value32 then
                local Highlight = t2.value32.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")

                if Highlight then
                    Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                end
            end
            if v159 then
                local Highlight = v159.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")

                if Highlight then
                    Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                end
            end
            t2.value32 = v159
            if v159 and v159.Parent then
                if t2.value32.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                    t2.value33 = t2.value4:GetPlayerFromCharacter(t2.value32.Parent)

                    return
                end
            else
                t2.value33 = nil
            end
        end)
    end
end

	Icon = "droplet",

	},
	New = function(_, _)
    function validateKey(p16)
        if not p16 then
            return false, "Key is invalid!"
        end

        if p16 == t2.value40 then
            return true, "Key is valid!"
        end

        return false, "Key is invalid!"
    end
    function copyLink()
        if request then
            local _request = request
            local t9 = {
					["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
					Origin = "https://discord.com"
				}
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local t10 = {
					code = "AF9qqekuNJ"
				}
            local JSONEncode = HttpService.JSONEncode
            local guid = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
            local v192 = JSONEncode(HttpService, {
					cmd = "INVITE_BROWSER",
					args = t10,
					nonce = guid
				})

            _request({
					Url = "http://127.0.0.1:6463/rpc?v=1",
					Method = "POST",
					Headers = t9,
					Body = v192
				})
        end

        return setclipboard("https://discord.gg/AF9qqekuNJ")
    end

    return {
			Verify = validateKey,
			Copy = copyLink
		}
end
}
